title: LITL One Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The LITL One (AKA Litl 1) vaporizer is a very simple and straight forward value vaporizer that offers users one temperature setting, 45-second heat up time, 850mah battery, ceramic chamber, a glass mouthpiece, haptic feedback and airflow control. All the basic features you need, perfect for those interested in an inexpensive way to try vaporizers for the first time.

Features:
Haptic Feedback
Discreet Device
Airflow Control
Isolated Airpath
Anodized Aluminum Shell
Ceramic Chamber
Stainless Steel
Glass Mouthpiece
90 Day Warranty

Included in the Box:
LITL One Vaporizer
USB Cable
